conclusions: There is no supported hosted B-only execution today. native-evidence always iterates the ordered l08 and normal RUNNERS; no existing CLI target, input, or safe workflow step-resume selects normal alone.

A reusable standalone normal runner already exists. A minimal explicit closed lane selection at the existing CI boundary could reuse run_native(normal) without rewriting that runner, but no such change is implemented or approved by this report.

If actual A25 functional-storage and retained-host evidence succeeds and a subsequent correction is B-only, assess and reuse the unaffected A scope rather than repeat expensive A work merely to obtain new B evidence. Retained strict file-protection failures must remain failures.

Full D provides separate KMP simulator runtime, Apple analysis/linkage, one normal Debug cold-launch smoke, and unsigned Release package coverage. It does not replace B repeated-launch or libproc provenance qualification; B likewise does not replace full D.

hosted_scope.finding: Closed scopes are full/native-preflight/native-evidence/native-process-probe. Preflight only binds; the probe is non-app; full is the combined gate. A failed-job rerun restarts the paired native job rather than only B.

standalone_normal.finding: The normal CLI accepts a fresh source binding and reviewed control hash, validates signing/toolchain/lifecycle, holds the exclusive lane lock, and performs its existing build, eight repetitions, external observation and finalizer. On a qualified Mac this is independently executable, but it is not an exposed B-only Actions path.

After any source/control correction, commit reviewed controls, regenerate/commit the mechanical inventory, and obtain fresh source/preflight/control bindings. Reused A evidence remains an execution at its original SHA with explicit scope-applicability reasoning, never new final-SHA runtime proof.

A shared app/fixture/toolchain/ownership/cleanup change may invalidate some A scope; determine this from the actual diff rather than blanket reuse. No shipping app source or normal runner rewrite is needed merely for lane selection.
